name: Gasthof Geierwallihof
beschreibung: The Gasthof Geierwallihof is located in Kaunertal in the municipality of Feichten. The inn's surroundings are characterized by the alpine landscape of the Tiroler Oberland. From here, guests have access to the hiking trails of Kaunertal and the nearby glacier ski area. The house is run as a traditional, family-run inn. The room furnishings follow the Alpine country style and offer modern comfort. Regional dishes are served in the inn's own restaurant. A wellness area with sauna and steam bath is available to guests. The Gasthof Geierwallihof is a suitable accommodation for active holidaymakers in Kaunertal.
